_comment_process: node directly on Next's real entrypoint, not the `node_modules/.bin/next` shim.
Same class of defect as the other two configs (see tmbilling-worker.json): that shim is
a /bin/sh script, so pm2 was supervising a shell rather than the Next server, and every
signal had to survive a hop that pm2 could not see past.
Lowest stakes of the three — a hard-killed Next server drops in-flight page renders and
nothing else, no locks and no money — but fixed alongside them so all three configs
state the same rule: pm2's pid IS the process, always.
name: tmbilling-dashboard
